resources.string: Ukhiye owodwa, le divayisi, ayikho i-akhawunti

Ukhiye uhlolwa ku-inthanethi kanye, uma uwufaka. Kusukela lapho kuqhubeke isitifiketi esisayiniwe seseva sisebenza ngokungaxhunyiwe ku-inthanethi kuze kuphele isikhathi saso — uhlelo lokusebenza alushayeli ekhaya njalo uma uvula isikrini. Isitifiketi siboshelwe ku-id yokufaka okungahleliwe yale divayisi, ngakho ukukopisha idatha yohlelo lokusebenza kwenye ifoni akuphathi ilayisensi nayo, futhi umnikazi angasetha kabusha lokho kubophezela kusuka kuphaneli uma ushintsha amafoni.
Isikhathi salo khiye siphelile. Ukhiye omusha uvuselela ukufinyelela.
Faka ukhiye owutholile ukuze uvule izindawo ezikhokhelwayo.

Amadeshi nosonhlamvukazi akusho lutho — kunamathisele njengoba ukutholile.
Yenziwe yasebenza. Le divayisi manje isixhunywe kukhiye wakho.
Lo khiye awubukeki uphelele. Kuhlole bese uzama futhi.
Lesi sakhiwo asinaso iseva yelayisensi emisiwe.
Alukho uxhumano. Ukhiye uthikhiwe kanye, bese usebenza ungaxhunyiwe ku-inthanethi.
Iseva yelayisensi ayizange iphendule ngesikhathi. Zama futhi.
Iseva yelayisensi iphendule ngephutha. Zama futhi emuva kwesikhathi.
Lo khiye ufinyelele umkhawulo wedivayisi. Cela ukusethwa kabusha kwedivayisi.
Le divayisi ayikaxhunywanga kukhiye okwamanje. Yenze isebenze lapha kuqala.
Imizamo eminingi kakhulu esuka kulolu xhumo — linda amaminithi ambalwa, bese uyazama futhi.
Kukhona into engahambanga kahle. Isizathu sarekhodwa kokuthi I-Diagnostics.
Ifakwe nokhiye. Ukhiye owodwa uvala le divayisi, futhi ukuyifaka kuthatha iminithi.
Iphaneli yokulawula ivale le ndawo. Ibuya ngemuva nje kokuthi inikwe amandla futhi.
